fragments.text: And thus let sanctification arise for Thee, For Thou art our God, O King.

he.text: The source prints הוא in parentheses without assigning an occasion; retained as a documentary variant.

fragments.text: The King sustains the earth in justice.

He is supreme over all the earth. The whole earth acknowledges and knows, all inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth, from one end of the earth to the other, that He is Creator of the ends of all the earth who does justice and righteousness on earth. When for justice He rises in court — the earth is silent — to save all the humble of the earth, to make as nought the judges of the earth, to grasp the corners of the earth and throw off all the evil-doers of the earth. Then aloud do they proclaim in heaven and on earth:
“How mighty is Thy Name throughout all the earth.”

When He rules over all the earth, the depths of the earth shout with joy, the heavens rejoice and the earth exults together with what is in the heavens above the earth and what is in the waters below the earth. Then do they joyfully shout in adoration:
“All the earth is full of His glory”.
The Lord reigns, the earth rejoices.

Three times will He let the Shofar blast be heard in dread and terrify the princes of dwellers on earth, and He will overthrow the thrones of the kingdoms of the earth so that all with breath in their nostrils on earth shall say:
“How mighty is Thy Name throughout all the earth.”
He establishes joy on the whole earth, arouses all who sleep in the earth, and they will lift up hymns of praise from the corner of the earth:
“sing to the Lord, all the earth”.

The earth and its inhabitants await the judgment, they tremble and quake for fear of the judgment, for great is the day of judgment. Who can endure it to justify himself in judgment? All judges and all who know law and judgment and all on whom judgment is to be done, fear lest they will not be favoured in judgment for there is no compassion in judgment. He does not show respect for persons in judgment. He is both witness and plaintiff in judgment, that there may be known on earth His work in judgment. The hand of every man seals the judgment, according to His rule does He perform for him judgment, and according to man’s deeds does He carry out judgment, man’s actions rebuke him in judgment, a stone from the wall cries out in judgment, a wooden beam answers in judgment, everything in truth and everything in judgment with the attribute of compassion and the attribute of judgment. This day is appointed for peoples in judgment, it is assigned as a day of judgment, and on it all souls will He bring to judgment.

It has been made a statute in memory of the first day and last day, to remember on it the sleepers of Hebron that in their shadow the lily of Sharon may shelter, those who return to divine protection may be acquitted on it, those who blow the Shofar and cry out aloud in order to profit from the righteousness of their forefathers and be saved through them from anger and wrath. Just as the father (Abraham) kept to the path of justice and clemency, so let kindness and clemency be done in judgment to his descendants. Just as the patient dove (Isaac) sowed clemency, so may his descendants reap truth and clemency. Just as clemency was granted to the one flawless in truth (Jacob) so may there be granted to his descendants truth and clemency. The throne of glory is founded on clemency. In front of Him stands a defender who pleads for clemency, and when the Shofar sounds on behalf of those in need of clemency, then the fathers of clemency entreat and implore and say before Him who loves clemency: “Far be it from Thee who dost speak with clemency, to do justice without clemency, even though in the place of justice there is no clemency and only where there is no justice, is there clemency. But Thou in judgment dost act with clemency to judge the world through acts of clemency, for the foundation of Thy throne is judgment and clemency; and when Thou dost examine deeds lacking in clemency, remember with favour the few deeds done with clemency, and with an unearned gift act with clemency to open for them the treasuries of clemency.”

en.text: Remaining verses of this poem which are of a mystical character, are

fragments.text: Our Father, our King, we have sinned before Thee.
Our Father, our King, we have no king but Thee.
Our Father, our King, deal with us kindly for the sake of Thy Name.
Our Father, our King, renew for us a good year.
Our Father, our King, annul all harsh decrees from upon us.
Our Father, our King, annul the plans of those that hate us.
Our Father, our King, frustrate the counsel of our enemies.
Our Father, our King, avert every foe and adversary from upon us.
Our Father, our King, avert pestilence, sword, famine, captivity and destruction from the children of Thy covenant.
Our Father, our King, hold back plague from Thine inheritance.
Our Father, our King, send complete healing to the sick of Thy people.
Our Father, our King, restore us in complete repentance before Thee.
Our Father, our King, pardon and forgive all our sins.
Our Father, our King, blot out our transgressions and let them pass away from before Thine eyes.
Our Father, our King, tear up the severe verdict decreed against us.
Our Father, our King, erase in Thy great compassion all the records of our faults.
Our Father, our King, remember that we are dust.
Our Father, our King, remember us benevolently before Thee.
Our Father, our King, inscribe us in the book of good life.
Our Father, our King, inscribe us in the book of merits.
Our Father, our King, inscribe us in the book of livelihood and sustenance.
Our Father, our King, inscribe us in the book of redemption and salvation.
Our Father, our King, inscribe us in the book of pardon and forgiveness.
Our Father, our King, let salvation soon spring forth for us.
Our Father, our King, raise the condition of Thy people.
Our Father, our King, raise the condition of Thine anointed.
Our Father, our King, hear our voice, spare us and have mercy on us.
Our Father, our King, accept our prayer with compassion and favour.
Our Father, our King, do not send us back empty from before Thee.
Our Father, our King, act for the sake of those slain for the sanctification of Thy Name.
Our Father, our King, act for the sake of those slaughtered for Thy unity.
Our Father, our King, act for the sake of those that go through fire and water for the sanctification of Thy Name.
Our Father, our King, revenge before our eyes the blood of Thy servants that was shed.
Our Father, our King, act for Thine own sake, if not for our sake.
Our Father, our King, act for Thine own sake and save us.
Our Father, our King, act for the sake of Thy great compassion.
Our Father, our King, act for the sake of Thy great, mighty and awe-inspiring Name that has been called over us.
Our Father, our King, be gracious and answer us for we have no good deeds. Deal with us in clemency and kindness and save us.

he.text: אין פֿירטה אונד אייניגען געמיינדען ווערדען פֿאן היער אן דיא אבינו מלכנו אין פֿאלגענדער ארדנונג געבעטעט: אבינו מלכנו מנע מגפה. א״מ החזירנו. סלח ומחל. מחה והעבר. מחוק ברחמיך. קרע רוע. שלח רפואה. זכור כי. זכרנו. כתבנו בספר חיים. זכיות. פרנסה. מחילה וסליחה. גאולה וישועה. הצמח לנו א״ז״וו.
The final abbreviation remains uncertain. א״ז״וו may represent German und so weiter (and so on); this is an editorial interpretation, not a confirmed source reading.

fragments.text: Exalted and sanctified be His great Name in the world that He has created according to His will. May His kingdom be established in your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of the whole House of Israel, speedily and in a short time, and say Amen.
May His Great Name be praised to eternity and the eternity of eternities.

Blessed and praised and glorified and elevated and exalted and adorned and raised on high and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He; high, yea high, above all blessing and song, praise and comfort that has ever been spoken in the world and say, Amen.
Accept our prayer with compassion and favour.
May the prayer and the entreaty of all Israel find favour before their Father in heaven and say, Amen.
Let the Name of the Lord be blessed from now unto eternity.
Let there be abundant peace from Heaven and life for us and for all Israel, and say Amen.
My help is from the Lord, creator of heaven and earth.
May He who makes peace in His heights, make peace for us and for all Israel, and say Amen.
And now let the power of the Lord appear great as Thou hast said.
Remember Thy mercies, O Lord, and Thine acts of loving-kindness for they exist since eternity.
There is none like Thee among the mighty ones O Lord and nought like Thy works.
Thy realm is a realm for all eternity and Thy rule over every generation.
The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, the Lord will reign for ever and ever.
The Lord gives strength to His people, the Lord blesses His people with peace.
O Father of mercy,
benefit Zion through Thy favour, build up the walls of Jerusalem.
For in Thee alone do we trust, O King, lofty and exalted God, master of eternity.

title.en: Prayer while the Scrolls of the Torah are taken out of the Ark

fragments.text: It was when the Holy Ark set out that Moses said: Arise, O Lord, that Thine enemies may be scattered and that those who hate Thee, may flee from Thy countenance.
From Zion does Torah go forth and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
Blessed be He, who in His holiness gave the Torah to His people Israel.
